How the camera works

OmniView holds your views, comparisons, and render handoffs. Research and image generation happen with your agent. A returned image is a reconstruction, not a historical photograph.

Source notes, visual inference, and scenario choices remain separate. The camera artwork is part of the interface, not an image of your destination.
